official_sources.name: DeepSeek API Docs - Change Log
official_sources.recorded_fact: DeepSeek V4-Pro and V4-Flash are supported with unchanged base_url; model should be deepseek-v4-pro or deepseek-v4-flash; legacy deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner stop on 2026-07-24.

official_sources.name: DeepSeek API Docs - V4 Preview Release
official_sources.recorded_fact: deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner are fully retired and inaccessible after 2026-07-24 15:59 UTC.

official_sources.name: DeepSeek API Docs - Models & Pricing
official_sources.recorded_fact: deepseek-v4-flash cache-miss input price is 0.14 USD per 1M tokens and output price is 0.28 USD per 1M tokens; legacy model names are deprecated on 2026-07-24 15:59 UTC.
